settings.wiring.title: Wiring
settings.wiring.label: Remotes map
settings.wiring.hint: Which deployment serves each workspace here. A workspace with no entry stays local — the default, and no setting.
settings.wiring.body: What a repository may send is its own manifest's call; this only says where it would go. A shared deployment serves one workspace and refuses a registration declaring another.
settings.wiring.none: Nothing is wired — every workspace on this machine stays local.
settings.wiring.fromEnvironment: The environment names this machine's remote, whole — the file below is not read while DAORIS_REMOTE_URL and DAORIS_REMOTE_KEY are set. What is listed is what is in effect.
settings.wiring.keyBody: The key is minted on the deployment's own console, per person per machine. It is stored in the file and never tracked, shown back, or sent anywhere but that deployment.
settings.wiring.keyTip: the key's audit prefix — the same handle the deployment's own key list shows
settings.wiring.unwired: {{workspace}} syncs nowhere from here now. Nothing at the deployment changed.
settings.wiring.wiredButOverridden: {{workspace}} is written to the map — but the environment names this machine's remote, so the file is not what is in effect. Unset it to use what you just wired.
